text: He dreamed of a “studio of the south” where artists would live and work together, and he talked Gauguin into joining him. The two men painted side by side for nine weeks, but they argued constantly. On the night of December 23, 1888, after a bad quarrel, Van Gogh cut off part of his left ear with a razor.
